result.instructions: Tools for SalesRabbit, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which leads did our reps add this week, and who owns them?"; "Show the status history of lead 12345."; "List our active users and their roles.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes SalesRabbit data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run salesrabbit_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run salesrabbit_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run salesrabbit_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. salesrabbit_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: salesrabbit_list_leads
tools.title: List leads
tools.description: List leads, filtered by status, owner, name, address, org unit, or changes since a time. Paged and sortable. Use it first to find lead ids. GET /leads.

owners.description: Owner user id, or the list of owner ids the API accepts.

postal_code.description: Postal or zip code of the lead address.

org_unit_id.description: Org unit id of the current lead owner.

modified_since.description: Lead changed since. ISO 8601 time with offset, e.g. 2026-01-01T00:00:00+00:00. Only records changed after it.

status_modified_since.description: Lead status changed since. ISO 8601 time with offset, e.g. 2026-01-01T00:00:00+00:00. Only records changed after it.

tools.name: salesrabbit_get_lead
tools.title: Get a lead
tools.description: Get one lead by id: contact details, address, status, owner, notes and custom fields. GET /leads/{leadId}.

tools.name: salesrabbit_list_lead_statuses
tools.title: List lead statuses
tools.description: List the lead statuses configured for the company (the values a lead's status can take). GET /leadStatuses.

tools.name: salesrabbit_get_lead_status
tools.title: Get a lead status
tools.description: Get one lead status by id. GET /leadStatuses/{leadStatusId}.

tools.name: salesrabbit_list_lead_status_history
tools.title: List lead status history
tools.description: List status changes across leads, filtered by status, owner, or when the status changed. Good for reports and polling. GET /leadStatusHistories.

owners.description: User ids of the status change, e.g. '911705141:911705521'.

status_updated.description: Status changed at, ISO 8601 without offset (UTC), e.g. 2026-01-01T00:00:00.

lead_modified.description: Lead modified at, ISO 8601 without offset (UTC).

modified_since.description: Lead changed since. ISO 8601 time with offset, e.g. 2026-01-01T00:00:00+00:00. Only records changed after it.

status_modified_since.description: Status changed since. ISO 8601 time with offset, e.g. 2026-01-01T00:00:00+00:00. Only records changed after it.

tools.name: salesrabbit_get_lead_status_history
tools.title: Get a lead's status history
tools.description: Get the status history of one lead by lead id. GET /leadStatusHistories/{leadId}.

tools.name: salesrabbit_list_users
tools.title: List users
tools.description: List company users (reps and managers), filtered by name, email, role or org unit. Page numbers start at 0. GET /users.

modified_since.description: User changed since. ISO 8601 time with offset, e.g. 2026-01-01T00:00:00+00:00. Only records changed after it.

tools.name: salesrabbit_get_user
tools.title: Get a user
tools.description: Get one user by id, including role and org unit. GET /users/{id}.

tools.name: salesrabbit_list_roles
tools.title: List roles and permissions
tools.description: List user roles with their permissions. Use it to check what a role may do. GET /rolePermissions.

tools.name: salesrabbit_list_org_units
tools.title: List org units
tools.description: List org units (departments, regions, offices, teams), filtered by type or status. GET /orgs.

tools.name: salesrabbit_get_org_unit
tools.title: Get an org unit
tools.description: Get one org unit by id. GET /orgs/{orgId}.

tools.name: salesrabbit_list_lead_custom_fields
tools.title: List lead custom fields
tools.description: List the custom fields defined for leads, with their names and types. GET /customFields/lead.

tools.name: salesrabbit_get_account
tools.title: Get account details
tools.description: Get basic details of the account that the access token belongs to. GET /api/account.

tools.name: salesrabbit_find_areas
tools.title: Find areas at a location
tools.description: Find the company areas that contain a latitude and longitude. With user_id, search only that user's assigned areas. GET /api/areas.

user_id.description: User id: search that user's assigned areas only.

tools.name: salesrabbit_create_lead
tools.title: Create a lead
tools.description: WRITES to the live SalesRabbit account: creates a new lead for the given owner and status. Confirm the owner, status and details with the user first. POST /leads.

custom_fields.description: Custom field values keyed by field name (see salesrabbit_list_lead_custom_fields).

tools.name: salesrabbit_update_lead
tools.title: Update a lead
tools.description: WRITES to the live SalesRabbit account: overwrites the given fields of one lead. Confirm the lead id and the new values with the user first. Only the fields you pass change. PUT /leads/{leadId}.

custom_fields.description: Custom field values keyed by field name (see salesrabbit_list_lead_custom_fields).
